name: Recital C
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: C. whereas the threat posed by Russia to Europe’s security and democratic integrity remains at unprecedented levels; whereas other actors, including China and Iran, also pose significant challenges; whereas it is necessary to address Europe’s decades-long underinvestment in defence and strengthen its contribution to collective defence, while developing a credible approach to information deterrence and, where appropriate, fully apply and enforce restrictive measures against actors responsible for foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI);
